sentences.text: However, the acquisition commenced on 13.08.2007 when Urgency Clause under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 was evoked.

It seems that notwithstanding the mandatory pre-condition, 80%
compensation or even less than that was not even offered to the affected land- owners including the petitioner.
No award was subsequently passed.
It was only in year 2024, that a notice purportedly under Section 9 of the old Act i.e., the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 was served.
The petitioner laid challenge to the said Notification.
The High Court has unfortunately passed a cryptic and unreasoned order thereby refusing to entertain the Writ Petition.

3. Issue notice, returnable on 21.10.2024.
4.
Meanwhile, the dispossession as well as the acquisition proceedings under the 1894 Act shall remain stayed.

However, the authorities shall be at liberty to initiate fresh acquisition process in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
